title: $1,000 in Bitcoin in 2015 is now worth this
caption:
In 2015, Bitcoin was a niche internet money.
$1,000 in it then would be worth about {growth:BTC-USD:2015-01-01} today (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: What would you have done with Bitcoin in 2015? 👇
sources: Bitcoin price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: In 2015, Bitcoin was a niche internet money.
Say you put in one thousand dollars.
Watch what it turns into. Today, it would be worth about {growth:BTC-USD:2015-01-01}.
Time in the market does the heavy lifting.
